title: Returns
text: Unused purchases with a receipt may be returned within 14 days of delivery. Worn items are excluded. Refunds go to the original payment method.

title: Delivery
text: Standard delivery takes 5 business days after dispatch. The dispatch email contains tracking. Weather delays may extend this estimate; it is not a guaranteed arrival date.

title: Warranty
text: Manufacturing defects are covered for 12 months after purchase. Submit a receipt and a photograph. Accidental damage and ordinary wear are excluded.

title: Cancellation
text: An order can be cancelled within 30 minutes of payment if packing has not started. Once packing starts, use the returns process after delivery.

title: Gift cards
text: Gift cards do not expire. They cannot be exchanged for cash through this service. A lost card can be replaced only with the original purchase receipt and card number.

title: Store pickup
text: Pickup orders are held for 7 days after the ready notice. Bring photo identification and the order confirmation. Uncollected orders are cancelled and refunded.

title: Damaged delivery
text: Report transit damage within 3 days of receipt. Keep the packaging and send photographs of the parcel and item. Staff arrange a replacement or refund after review.

title: Price adjustment
text: One price adjustment is available within 10 days of purchase when this same brand reduces its own public price. Competitor prices and clearance purchases are excluded.
